manifest.primary: mean focal placement; lower is better
manifest.uncertainty: five seed-block means per population/visibility; eight seat rotations are correlated

hypotheses.earlierUpgrades: Add the 2/4/6/8/10 round cadence and smaller board readiness threshold; retain Tempo valuation, survival reserve and mandatory-action priority.
hypotheses.fundReplacement: At an otherwise finished full-board turn with two gold, sell the weakest unit to afford an improving offer. Require empty hand, action headroom and no competing upgrade budget.

manifest.promotion: No automatic promotion. Examine both populations, block variation and factorial effects; small cohort estimates are not general strength guarantees.
